About the M4A1-S | Decimator

With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic. The M4A1-S | Decimator is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Decimator finish on the M4A1-S. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The M4A1-S | Decimator can be unboxed from the Spectrum Case. It belongs to the Spectrum Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.85. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The M4A1-S | Decimator (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $84.99, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $14.46 (Battle-Scarred) to $84.99 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The M4A1-S | Decimator has a community rating of 4.0 out of 5 based on 277 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among M4A1-S skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the M4A1-S | Decimator?

Factory New (FN) M4A1-S | Decimator skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Decimator pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the M4A1-S | Decimator a good budget option?

Yes, the M4A1-S | Decimator is an excellent budget-friendly choice. Priced affordably, it offers the Decimator aesthetic without breaking the bank. Budget skins like this are ideal for players building their first inventory or those who prefer spending on multiple skins rather than one expensive item. The lower price point also means less financial risk if you decide to trade or sell later.

What is the float value range for the M4A1-S | Decimator?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.85, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the M4A1-S | Decimator?

Prices for the M4A1-S | Decimator vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Spectrum Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the M4A1-S | Decimator in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the M4A1-S | Decimator are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the M4A1-S | Decimator price going up or down?

The M4A1-S | Decimator has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the M4A1-S | Decimator from?

The M4A1-S | Decimator is part of the The Spectrum Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Spectrum Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the M4A1-S | Decimator?

The in-game description reads: "With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic." The Decimator finish on the M4A1-S is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.
